preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some Gator tokens to demonstrate the issue

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is that tokens sent to the burn address (0x000...dEaD) are not actually burned (total supply not reduced). Instead, they're just transferred to a dead address. To demonstrate, transfer tokens to the BURN_ADDRESS (0x000...dEaD) and observe that totalSupply() remains unchanged, proving tokens aren't burned. The contract's _transfer function calls super._transfer(sender, BURN_ADDRESS, burnAmount) which doesn't invoke _burn, so total supply isn't reduced.
